ruleSummary: Represent total exclusion as exact blocker-to-blockee pairs rather than a generic blocking switch.
conditions: The named blocker is present and eligible.
Only the exact pair admitted by an atomic rule may produce total exclusion.
exclusions: Share reduction is not total exclusion.
Parents, spouses, and direct children are not made blockees by this record.
Female-sibling and extended-agnate relationships shown by Khulasa but absent from the captured KZ-FR-011 passage require their own parent evidence before admission.
blockingAndPriorityInteractions: Total exclusion is resolved before assigning a share to the named blockee.
A nearer son's-line descendant may also block a more remote son's son, but generation-depth execution is outside the MVP.
The functional direct-family MVP uses these atoms only to keep unsupported distant heirs from being treated as eligible.

sourceAgreement.detail: The exact father and son pairs selected for atomic candidates appear without conflict in both sources.

unresolvedQuestions: Generation-depth handling among multiple son's sons is outside the current heir model.
Additional female and extended-agnate blocker pairs are not part of this fast MVP pass.

atomicCandidateAssessment.rationale: Each candidate names one blocker and one blockee, preventing a vague aggregate blocking rule.

admissionBlockers: Exact positive, negative, and coexistence fixtures plus a separate admission review remain required.
